final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and to meet the docstring specifications:

- In export.py, I updated to_csv_row to properly escape item names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In pricing.py, I enhanced parse_price to handle thousands separators (commas) and accounting-style negative prices with parentheses.
- In pricing.py, I updated apply_discount to use the "round half up" rounding mode as specified.
- In report.py, I fixed low_stock to return item names with quantity strictly below the threshold and sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

After these fixes, all tests pass successfully.
